chapter: First jobs and finding his sound
title: Leaving Lansing in 1941
summary: He left home right after high school in 1941 and never returned to live.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I have two questions to ask you. One was, when did you first leave your home--you know--leave your father's home and go out and stay on the road or whatever.
I left in 1941...yeah...and I didn't come back. I didn't come back. No. I was gone then.
So you got out of high school and you stayed there for another year?
No, right after high school I went on out there.
